item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-30
item.description:
Our community has seen exciting progress across multiple projects recently. In the **scienceverse/metacheck** repository, the `data_check` branch now includes statistical output capability, thanks to a targeted addition to the Lakens method. Meanwhile, **marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing** has been updated with a site build for version 0.4.1 and a tweak to the success alert title in `sweet_alert.js`. Notably, **quest-bih/oddpub** has made significant updates to its ontogenerator, including code validation and the addition of "nature das and cas detection". These advancements demonstrate the connections between our projects, with a focus on enhancing statistical functionality, user experience, and data analysis capabilities. Furthermore, **Davidvandijcke/coarse** has made substantial security improvements, including a fix to "harden release audit and workflows", and has refreshed its models with a deep literature search, showcasing the community's commitment to robust and reliable research tools.

15 commits across 3 active repositories this week.

Most active:

metacheck3 commits
oddpub1 commits

item.title: coarse: 11 commits today
item.description:
Davidvandijcke/coarse

The `main` branch was updated with a merge from the `dev` branch. The `dev` branch itself was updated with a merge from the `codex/fix-release-audit` branch, which included a fix to "harden release audit and workflows" for security. The `codex/fix-release-audit` branch also had its models refreshed and a deep literature search added, as described in the commit "Refresh frontier models and add deep literature search". Additionally, the `codex/fix-release-audit` branch was prepared for release version "v1.9.0" with a chore commit. The `feat/latest-models-deep-literature` branch had a feature added to "refresh models and add deep literature search", and later had a fix to "address pre-pr rollout findings". The `codex/fix-release-audit` branch also merged changes from the `codex/sync-main-v1.9.0` and `codex/release-v1.9.0` branches, and reconciled the main Fable hotfix into dev.
